gaps.title: Zingaresca
gaps.scoring: violin and piano, or violin solo with orchestra (morceau de concert)
gaps.edition: Paris/Milan: G. Ricordi, 1912 (both the violin & piano and the violin & orchestra editions are in the BnF catalogue)
gaps.note: Gypsy-style concert piece, companion to the Csárdás. Also listed on English Wikipedia (Ricordi 1912). Key, length and level unverified (no score seen); minutes/level are estimates.

gaps.title: Coquetterie
gaps.scoring: violin and piano (or harps and string quintet)
gaps.edition: G. Ricordi, 1913 (BnF records for violin & piano and for 'violon solo avec accompagnement de piano (ou harpes et quintette à cordes)')
gaps.note: Also on English Wikipedia (Ricordi 1913). Salon piece; level/length are estimates.

gaps.title: Kamtchatka (danse sibérienne)
gaps.edition: G. Ricordi, 1909 ('Kamtchatka (danse sibérienne), pour violon avec accompagnement de piano', BnF)
gaps.note: Single catalogue source (BnF); obscure salon dance, add only if the catalogue wants Monti beyond the Csárdás. Level/length are estimates.

gaps.title: Sicilienne
gaps.edition: Ricordi, 1921 and 1926 printings ('Sicilienne pour violon et piano ou harpe', BnF)
gaps.note: Single catalogue source (BnF); key not seen, so none in the title. Obscure salon piece; level/length are estimates.
